nodes.label: #479 Shrink-Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json() refuses to write graph.json (returns False) when the newly built graph has fewer nodes than the existing one on disk, so a partial or failed extraction can never silently clobber a good graph; GRAPH_REPORT.md and the analysis sidecar are only written after a successful, non-shrinking export.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be {full-path-stem}_{entity}, every directory segment kept, so semantic-subagent IDs match the AST extractor's ID scheme exactly; using just the filename or only the immediate parent directory creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes when merged with AST output.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges must pick one of five fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) rather than a free continuous 0-1 range, because models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges - production data showed a bimodal collapse (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when a continuous range was allowed, so the range guidance was being ignored in favor of a binary default.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify's query matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch between the user's question and the graph's node-label vocabulary collapses the answer to noise; the fix is to extract the graph's actual label vocabulary first and pick only real vocab tokens (never invented ones) before traversal.

nodes.label: Work Memory / Self-Improving Loop
nodes.rationale: save-result --outcome useful|dead_end|corrected builds preferred sources and known dead ends into graphify-out/reflections/LESSONS.md via `graphify reflect`, so later sessions start by reading lessons instead of re-deriving the same dead-end queries.

nodes.label: Stamp-Only-On-Output Manifest Rule
nodes.rationale: Only doc/paper/image files that actually produced extraction output this run get stamped in the manifest; a changed file whose chunk failed or was omitted must stay unstamped so the next --update re-queues it, otherwise (#2015) it is marked done and its content is lost forever.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges pick one of five fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) instead of a continuous range, because a continuous range was observed collapsing to a bimodal 0.5/0.85+ split in production.

nodes.label: PowerShell 5.1 Scrolling Fix
nodes.rationale: ANSI escape sequences emitted by the graspologic library break vertical scrolling in the legacy PowerShell console; fix is to upgrade graphify (v0.3.10+ suppresses the output), use Windows Terminal, reset the terminal, or uninstall graspologic to fall back to NetworkX's Louvain implementation which emits no ANSI output. This Windows-specific section is unique to the .claude copy of SKILL.md.
